member.name: M:RaceDay.Controllers.AuthController.Register(RaceDay.DTOs.Registration)
member.summary: Registers a new user as either an Organiser or a Participant. Creates the base User record and links it to the corresponding profile table. Password is hashed using BCrypt.
member.param: Registration details: username, email, password, role, name, and phone.
member.returns: 201 Created on success, 400 Bad Request if the email already exists or the role is invalid.

member.name: M:RaceDay.Controllers.AuthController.Login(RaceDay.DTOs.Login)
member.summary: Authenticates a user with email and password. Creates a server-side session storing the UserID and UserRole for all subsequent authorized requests.
member.returns: 200 OK with userID and role on success, 401 Unauthorized on invalid credentials.
